# Post-Completion Phase Three: Final Critique

> The Awtsmoos keeps a quiet icon from disturbing the proven world below;
> Awtsmoos.com lets documentation mirror production wherever future maintainers go.

## Final Critique

The route shell is only sixty-two lines, so a full rewrite is safer than a partial insertion. The SVG must remain independent of ignored media and Drive-backed runtime assets. The test must verify behaviorally important shell contracts without becoming a brittle full-HTML snapshot. Documentation must distinguish stable architecture from dated production evidence.

## Thirty Final Checks

1. Preserve B"H, Boruch Hashem, and Blessed is He at every new file opening.
2. Keep every touched file below 120 lines.
3. Use tabs where indentation exists.
4. Keep SVG self-contained.
5. Avoid script in SVG.
6. Avoid external image references.
7. Avoid external fonts.
8. Include a square viewBox.
9. Include accessible metadata.
10. Use current route palette.
11. Reference the icon relatively.
12. Preserve import map entries.
13. Preserve stylesheet URL.
14. Preserve compact entry URL.
15. Preserve root element ID.
16. Preserve loading and HUD structure.
17. Preserve viewport and theme color.
18. Test the icon declaration exactly once.
19. Test the icon file exists.
20. Test the icon has no `http:` or `https:` dependency.
21. Test the compact entry remains present.
22. Test the runtime root remains present.
23. Update the true global name to `AwtsmoosMitzvahWorld`.
24. Document the compact build script.
25. Document the model Drive root.
26. Document essential versus rich feature boundaries.
27. Close all old unchecked tasks.
28. Keep current production evidence dated.
29. Deploy only exact intended files.
30. Re-run a fresh browser trace after deployment.
31. Require zero non-favicon regressions.
32. Require the favicon itself to return HTTP 200.
33. Verify movement still changes player position.
34. Preserve unrelated local work.

## Final Decision

Proceed with five source artifacts only: route shell, route icon, route-shell test, next-AI handoff, and closed remaining-work ledger. Do not regenerate CompactJS because no reachable JavaScript source changes in this pass.
